class FeedbackModel(RetryModel):
    """Scripted patch generation with real Docker failures as its input."""

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.saw_pytest_failure = False

    def generate(self, schema, payload):
        if schema is Patch and self.attempt:
            test = payload["tests"][-1]
            assert test["evidence"] == "docker" and test["status"] == "failed"
            assert test["failed"] > 0 and "401" in test["stdout"]
            self.saw_pytest_failure = True

class PublicationDouble:
    """Remote writes are replaced; approval still requires real Docker test evidence."""

    def __init__(self, fail: bool = False):
        self.calls = 0
        self.fail = fail

    def publish(self, state: dict) -> str:
        self.calls += 1
        assert state["approval_status"] == "approved"
        if self.fail:
            raise TimeoutError("Simulated uncertain remote write")
        return "https://github.com/example/fixture/pull/1"


@pytest.fixture
def approved_task(tmp_path: Path):
    root = Path(__file__).parents[2] / "test_fixtures" / "repair_repository"
    settings = Settings(repository_root=root, data_dir=tmp_path / "data")
    service = TaskService(settings)
    task = service.create(
        TaskRequest(repository_path=str(root), issue_description="expired token should return 401")
    )
    state = service.run(task["task_id"])
    assert state["execution_status"] == "awaiting_approval"
    yield service, settings, state
    service.close()


def test_publication_gate_and_repeated_success(approved_task):
    service, settings, state = approved_task
    publisher = PublicationDouble()
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Explicit human approval"):
        service.publish(state["task_id"], state["diff_digest"], publisher=publisher)
    assert publisher.calls == 0
    service.decide(state["task_id"], True, state["diff_digest"])
    first = service.publish(state["task_id"], state["diff_digest"], publisher=publisher)
    assert service.publish(state["task_id"], state["diff_digest"], publisher=publisher) == first
    assert publisher.calls == 1
    restored = TaskService(settings)
    try:
        assert (
            restored.publish(state["task_id"], state["diff_digest"], publisher=publisher) == first
        )
        assert publisher.calls == 1
    finally:
        restored.close()


def test_uncertain_publication_is_not_replayed(approved_task):
    service, _, state = approved_task
    service.decide(state["task_id"], True, state["diff_digest"])
    publisher = PublicationDouble(fail=True)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="interrupted"):
        service.publish(state["task_id"], state["diff_digest"], publisher=publisher)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="uncertain"):
        service.publish(state["task_id"], state["diff_digest"], publisher=publisher)
    assert publisher.calls == 1

ROOT = Path(__file__).parents[2]


@pytest.mark.parametrize("point,exit_code", [("before-test", 77), ("after-write", 78)])
def test_process_loss_resumes_recorded_patch_or_refuses_unrecorded_write(tmp_path, point, exit_code):
    settings = Settings(repository_root=ROOT / "test_fixtures" / "repair_repository", data_dir=tmp_path / "data")
    service = TaskService(settings)
    task = service.create(TaskRequest(
        repository_path=str(settings.repository_root),
        issue_description="expired token returns 500, expected 401",
    ))
    service.close()
    env = dict(os.environ)
    env.pop("OPENAI_API_KEY", None)
    env.pop("GITHUB_TOKEN", None)
    env["REPOPILOT_MODEL_MODE"] = "mock"
    result = subprocess.run([
        sys.executable, "-I", "-c",
        "import app, runpy, sys; sys.argv = sys.argv[1:]; "
        "runpy.run_path(sys.argv[0], run_name='__main__')",
        str(ROOT / "tests/integration/recovery_worker.py"), str(settings.data_dir),
        str(settings.repository_root), task["task_id"], point,
    ], cwd=ROOT, env=env, capture_output=True, timeout=45)
    assert result.returncode == exit_code, result.stderr.decode(errors="replace")
    assert (settings.data_dir / "crash-marker.txt").exists()
    assert (settings.data_dir / "worker-app.txt").read_text(encoding="utf8") == str(
        Path(app.__file__).resolve())
    restarted = TaskService(settings)
    try:
        state = restarted.get(task["task_id"])
        if point == "after-write":
            assert state["attempts"] == 0
            with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="outside the recorded repair"):
                restarted.run(task["task_id"])
            assert restarted.diff(task["task_id"])["diff"]
            assert not restarted.get(task["task_id"])["test_results"]
        else:
            assert state["attempts"] == 1 and len(state["patches"]) == 1
            state = restarted.run(task["task_id"])
            assert state["execution_status"] == "awaiting_approval"
            assert state["attempts"] == 1 and len(state["patches"]) == 1
            assert state["test_results"][-1]["status"] == "passed"
            assert state["test_results"][-1]["evidence"] == "docker"
            assert state["test_results"][-1]["image_id"]
    finally:
        restarted.close()

def windows_denied(code=5):
    error = PermissionError('Controlled Windows activation failure')
    error.winerror = code
    return error


@pytest.mark.parametrize('code', [5, 32, 33])
def test_transient_windows_rename_uses_same_prepared_identity_and_three_tries(tmp_path, monkeypatch, code):
    baseline = tmp_path / 'baseline'
    baseline.mkdir()
    (baseline / 'target.py').write_text('value = 1\n')
    original = Path.rename
    ids = []

    def rename(path, target):
        ids.append(json.loads((path / 'candidate.json').read_text())['candidate_id'])
        if len(ids) < 3:
            raise windows_denied(code)
        return original(path, target)

    monkeypatch.setattr(Path, 'rename', rename)
    candidate = prepare_candidate(tmp_path, 1, file_manifest(baseline))
    assert len(ids) == 3 and len(set(ids)) == 1 and ids[0] == candidate['candidate_id']

@pytest.mark.parametrize("fault,kind,retryable", [
    (429, "rate_limit", True), (503, "provider_unavailable", True),
    (401, "credentials", False), ("timeout", "timeout", True),
])
def test_actual_sdk_error_reaches_persistent_recovery_state(tmp_path, monkeypatch,
                                                          fault, kind, retryable):
    monkeypatch.setenv("OPENAI_API_KEY", "test-only-not-a-real-key")
    requests = []
    fixture = MockModel()

    def handler(request):
        body = json.loads(request.content)
        requests.append(body)
        if len(requests) == 1:
            if fault == "timeout":
                raise httpx.ReadTimeout("controlled timeout", request=request)
            return httpx.Response(fault, json={"error": {"message": "private-provider-detail"}},
                                  headers={"retry-after": "0"})
        schema_name = body["tools"][0]["function"]["name"]
        schema = {"Plan": Plan, "Patch": Patch, "Review": Review}[schema_name]
        payload = json.loads(body["messages"][1]["content"])
        value, _ = fixture.generate(schema, payload)
        return httpx.Response(200, json={
            "id": "controlled-response", "model": "controlled-model", "created": 0,
            "object": "chat.completion",
            "choices": [{"index": 0, "finish_reason": "tool_calls", "message": {
                "role": "assistant", "content": None, "tool_calls": [{
                    "id": "controlled-call", "type": "function", "function": {
                        "name": schema_name, "arguments": value.model_dump_json(),
                    },
                }],
            }}],
            "usage": {"prompt_tokens": 8, "completion_tokens": 3, "total_tokens": 11},
        })

    settings = Settings(repository_root=Path(__file__).parents[2] / "test_fixtures" / "repair_repository",
                        data_dir=tmp_path / "data")
    model = LiveModel(settings)
    client = httpx.Client(transport=httpx.MockTransport(handler))
    model.client = ChatOpenAI(model="controlled-model", http_client=client, max_retries=0)
    service = TaskService(settings, model=model, runner=EvidenceDouble())
    try:
        task = service.create(TaskRequest(repository_path=str(settings.repository_root),
                                          issue_description="expired token should return 401"))
        state = service.run(task["task_id"])
        assert state["failure"]["kind"] == kind
        assert state["execution_status"] == ("retryable" if retryable else "failed")
        assert state["model_calls"] == 1 and not state["token_usage_complete"]
        assert "private-provider-detail" not in json.dumps(state)
        if retryable:
            service.graph.update_state(service._config(state["thread_id"]), {
                "failure": {**state["failure"], "retry_at": 0},
            })
            recovered = service.run(task["task_id"])
            assert recovered["execution_status"] == "awaiting_approval"
            assert recovered["model_calls"] == 4
            assert recovered["input_tokens"] + recovered["output_tokens"] == 33
            assert not recovered["token_usage_complete"]
    finally:
        service.close()
        client.close()

class TemporaryFailure(MockModel):
    """Controlled provider-failure double, not real LLM evidence."""

    def __init__(self, schema=Plan, *, always=False, retryable=True):
        self.schema, self.always, self.retryable = schema, always, retryable
        self.failures = 0

    def generate(self, schema, payload):
        if schema is self.schema and (self.always or not self.failures):
            self.failures += 1
            raise ModelFailure("Model request failed: ControlledTransportFailure", {
                "calls": 1, "input_tokens": 0, "output_tokens": 0,
                "usage_complete": False,
                "failure": {"kind": "rate_limit" if self.retryable else "credentials",
                            "retryable": self.retryable, "retry_after_seconds": 300},
            })
        return super().generate(schema, payload)


def settings_for(tmp_path, **kwargs):
    return Settings(repository_root=Path(__file__).parents[2] / "test_fixtures" / "repair_repository",
                    data_dir=tmp_path / "data", **kwargs)


def create(service):
    return service.create(TaskRequest(
        repository_path=str(service.settings.repository_root),
        issue_description="expired token returns 500, expected 401",
    ))["task_id"]


def expire_cooldown(service, task_id):
    state = service.get(task_id)
    service.graph.update_state(service._config(state["thread_id"]),
                               {"failure": {**state["failure"], "retry_at": 0}})


@pytest.mark.parametrize("failed_schema", [Plan, Patch, Review])
def test_resume_persists_and_retries_only_failed_model_node(tmp_path, failed_schema):
    settings = settings_for(tmp_path)
    service = TaskService(settings, model=TemporaryFailure(failed_schema), runner=EvidenceDouble())
    task_id = create(service)
    failed = service.run(task_id)
    assert failed["execution_status"] == "retryable"
    assert not failed["token_usage_complete"]
    with TestClient(create_app(service=service)) as api:
        denied = api.post(f"/api/tasks/{task_id}/resume")
        assert denied.status_code == 409 and "cooldown" in denied.json()["detail"]
    expire_cooldown(service, task_id)
    service.close()
    restarted = TaskService(settings, model=MockModel(), runner=EvidenceDouble())
    try:
        result = restarted.run(task_id)
        assert result["execution_status"] == "awaiting_approval"
        assert result["attempts"] == 1
        assert len(result["patches"]) == len(result["test_results"]) == 1
        assert result["provider_retry_count"] == 1
        assert result["model_calls"] == 1  # One failed controlled call; MockModel reports zero.
        assert not result["token_usage_complete"]
        assert result["failure"] is None
    finally:
        restarted.close()


def test_repeated_failure_exhausts_manual_provider_budget(tmp_path):
    service = TaskService(settings_for(tmp_path, max_retries=1),
                          model=TemporaryFailure(always=True), runner=EvidenceDouble())
    try:
        task_id = create(service)
        service.run(task_id)
        expire_cooldown(service, task_id)
        state = service.run(task_id)
        assert state["execution_status"] == "failed"
        assert state["failure"]["budget_exhausted"]
        assert state["provider_retry_count"] == 1 and state["model_calls"] == 2
        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="not resumable"):
            service.check_resume(task_id)
    finally:
        service.close()


def test_permanent_provider_error_is_terminal(tmp_path):

                          runner=EvidenceDouble())

        assert not state["failure"]["retryable"]
    finally:

def test_unrecorded_edit_before_first_checkpoint_blocks_resume(tmp_path):
    service = TaskService(settings_for(tmp_path), runner=EvidenceDouble())
    try:
        task_id = create(service)
        state = service.get(task_id)
        target = Path(state["workspace_path"]) / "auth.py"
        target.write_text(target.read_text(encoding="utf8") + "\n# unrecorded\n", encoding="utf8")
